title: Exclude funded P104 rank-two virtual cuts (0% κ change)
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed #7113, replace one public cohort rank-two ascent with two adjacent rank-one MOVEs through a rank-four or rank-five chart. Use that inserted cut for a productive rank-nine 4+5 split, retaining all other chronology and ownership. The independently reproduced complete comparator is κ = 0.00364665195644.

The forward and reverse geometry walks agree on 95 distinct movers and all 285 quotient midpoint subspaces. Of those, 254 have no existing chart label, and all 31 labelled banks are empty at the original pre-MOVE cut. One singleton support test per mover covers its three midpoint choices. Every mover has exact exterior support on both sides. The rational and modular witnesses agree. The declared fixed-contact scope exhausted with zero unresolved cases.

The complete 17-copy debit removes one rank-two paid call per copy, adds two rank-one calls and changes productive targets by `T4 +17, T5 +17, T9 −17`. The optimistic one-edit net upper is 0.29487996463827 raw, and the 95-mover relaxation is 28.013596640635633 raw before ancillary work. Compatible saving in scope is zero.

## Task and replay

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, revision 8, on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. This inserts a paid cut. #7359 keeps paid clocks fixed, while #7143 and #7147 use timed gathers and owned buffers. Retiming other paths or adding a cocharted carrier is outside scope.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-two-virtual-cut-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rank-two-virtual-cut-bound
```

The CPython 3.12 replay regenerates nine exact receipts and rejects a changed price and word. Local registered, committed byte/mode/source-history, navigation and official Git-free checks passed. The branch carries the existing #7257 onboarding repair. No complete candidate advanced.

## Credit

#7334 supplies the word, #7113 the caller, #7298 the directed tariff, #5599 and #7339 the two-sided support method, and #7117/#7143/#7147 the earlier funded split mechanisms. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
